authoring.note: A small residential building in Redoubt Shore, available to become a PC's home.

lore.summary: A small stone-built house on the thin spit of Redoubt Shore, one of only a handful of buildings facing the old fort across the water. The pilot station and the boat slip are the only other reasons anyone comes out this far; most days the loudest thing here is the water itself. Whoever ends up living here will have chosen distance from the city on purpose.
lore.playerFacing: Salt-stained render, a chimney that leans very slightly, and a view straight across the water to the fort -- close enough to watch the tide change against its walls, far enough that the crossing has to be planned for, never assumed.

hooks: The pilot station's own comings and goings are visible from the front step, at all hours, whether anyone living here wants to notice them or not.
